subject: Unable to reset my password
body:
Hi Support Team,
I’ve been trying to reset my password since yesterday, but I never receive
the reset email. I checked spam as well.
Can someone help me regain access to my account?
Thanks,
Rahul
reasoning: Existing user reporting a password reset issue and requesting help regaining account access — a clear technical support request.

subject: Need information about account and pricing
body:
Hi,
I’m currently using the free version, but I’m also facing issues with login
verification emails not arriving.
At the same time, I wanted to understand whether your premium plans support
multiple users.
Please advise.
Regards,
Sanjay
reasoning: The sender is an existing free-tier user experiencing a technical issue (login verification emails not arriving), which is a support concern. They also ask about premium plan features (multi-user support), which is a lead signal. The login issue is the more urgent/actionable problem blocking their use of the product, so support is the primary intent, though the pricing inquiry lowers confidence.
